# ============================================================
# Reproduce cmhc_get_table_data
# Purpose: Fetch the data behind MapleStats MCP's cmhc_get_table_data
#          (exact: the request the tool made, recorded while it ran)
# Inputs:  https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable
# Outputs: data/raw/ExportTable.csv; the prepared table as `data`
# ============================================================

# 0. Setup ----

library(dplyr)
library(httr2)
library(janitor)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. Read inputs ----

request("https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable") |>
  req_body_form(!!!list(`TableId` = "5.6.1", `GeographyId` = "1", `GeographyTypeId` = "1", `exportType` = "csv")) |>
  req_perform(path = "data/raw/ExportTable.csv")

# The file opens with 2 title line(s) above its header; read the table between.

lines <- read_lines("data/raw/ExportTable.csv", skip = 2)
data <- read_delim(I(str_c(lines, collapse = "\n")), delim = ",",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))

# 2. Check inputs ----

stopifnot("https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable returned no rows" = nrow(data) > 0)

# 3. Prepare data ----

data <- data |>
  clean_names()

# Standard cleaning: trimmed text, empty strings as missing, and numbers
# stored as text converted to numbers. Codes stay text as the source
# wrote them: columns named like one (coordinate, vector_id, dguid, NAICS,
# postal code) and columns with a leading zero (01, 000000001).

code_columns <- "^(coordinate|vector|vector_?id|product_?id|pid|dguid|[a-z0-9_]*_dguid|postal_?code|[a-z0-9_]*_postal_code|fsa|[a-z0-9_]*naics[a-z0-9_]*|noc|noc_[a-z0-9_]*|[a-z0-9_]*_noc|sgc|sgc_[a-z0-9_]*|[a-z0-9_]*_sgc)$"
data <- data |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), \(x) na_if(str_trim(x), "")))
keep_text <- names(data)[
  str_detect(names(data), code_columns) |
    map_lgl(
      data,
      \(column) is.character(column) && any(str_detect(column, "^-?0[0-9]"), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
]
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    across(any_of(keep_text), \(x) if (is.list(x)) x else as.character(x)),
    across(where(is.character) & !any_of(keep_text), parse_guess)
  )
scripts.python:
# ============================================================
# Reproduce cmhc_get_table_data
# Purpose: Fetch the data behind MapleStats MCP's cmhc_get_table_data
#          (exact: the request the tool made, recorded while it ran)
# Inputs:  https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable
# Outputs: data/raw/ExportTable.csv; the prepared table as `data`
# ============================================================

# %% 0. Setup

import io
import re
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

import httpx
import polars as pl

RAW_DIR = Path("data/raw")
RAW_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
raw_path = RAW_DIR / "ExportTable.csv"

# %% 1. Read inputs

with httpx.Client(
    http2=True,
    follow_redirects=True,
    timeout=300,
    headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; research script)"},
) as client:
    response = client.post('https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable', data={'TableId': '5.6.1', 'GeographyId': '1', 'GeographyTypeId': '1', 'exportType': 'csv'})
response.raise_for_status()
raw_path.write_bytes(response.content)

# The file opens with 2 title line(s) above its header; read the table between.

lines = raw_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[2:]
data = pl.read_csv(io.StringIO("\n".join(lines)), separator=',', infer_schema=False)

# %% 2. Check inputs

assert data.height > 0, "https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable returned no rows"

# %% 3. Prepare data

# Standard cleaning: snake_case names as janitor's clean_names() gives them
# in R (PÉRIODE -> periode, referenceNumber -> reference_number, # -> number,
# % -> percent, apostrophes dropped, a leading digit prefixed with x),
# trimmed text, empty strings as missing. Names that clean alike are
# numbered as janitor numbers them (Indicator, indicator -> indicator,
# indicator_2).

clean_names = [
    re.sub(
        r"[^0-9a-z]+",
        "_",
        re.sub(
            r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])",
            r"\1_\2",
            "".join(
                " " if unicodedata.category(ch)[0] in "PS" and not ch.isascii() else ch
                for ch in unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", column.replace("'", ""))
            )
            .replace("#", " number ")
            .replace("%", " percent ")
            .encode("ascii", "ignore")
            .decode(),
        ).lower(),
    ).strip("_")
    or "x"
    for column in data.columns
]
clean_names = [f"x{name}" if name[0].isdigit() else name for name in clean_names]
while len(set(clean_names)) < len(clean_names):
    name_counts = {}
    numbered = []
    for name in clean_names:
        name_counts[name] = name_counts.get(name, 0) + 1
        count = name_counts[name]
        numbered.append(name if count == 1 else f"{name}_{count}")
    clean_names = numbered
data = data.rename(dict(zip(data.columns, clean_names)))
data = data.with_columns(pl.col(pl.Utf8).str.strip_chars().replace("", None))

# Numbers stored as text become numbers. Codes stay text as the source
# wrote them: columns named like one (coordinate, vector_id, dguid, NAICS,
# postal code) and columns with a leading zero (01, 000000001).

code_columns = re.compile(r"^(coordinate|vector|vector_?id|product_?id|pid|dguid|[a-z0-9_]*_dguid|postal_?code|[a-z0-9_]*_postal_code|fsa|[a-z0-9_]*naics[a-z0-9_]*|noc|noc_[a-z0-9_]*|[a-z0-9_]*_noc|sgc|sgc_[a-z0-9_]*|[a-z0-9_]*_sgc)$")
for column in data.columns:
    dtype = data.schema[column]
    if code_columns.search(column) and not dtype.is_nested():
        data = data.with_columns(pl.col(column).cast(pl.Utf8))
        continue
    if dtype != pl.Utf8 or data[column].null_count() == data.height:
        continue
    numbers = data[column].cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
    leading_zero = data[column].str.contains(r"^-?0[0-9]").any()
    if numbers.null_count() > data[column].null_count() or leading_zero:
        continue
    whole = data[column].cast(pl.Int64, strict=False)
    data = data.with_columns(whole if whole.null_count() == numbers.null_count() else numbers)

import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import httpx
import polars as pl
RAW_DIR = Path("data/raw")
RAW_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
raw_path = RAW_DIR / "ExportTable.csv"
with httpx.Client(http2=True, follow_redirects=True, timeout=300, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; research script)"}) as client: response = client.post('https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable', data={'TableId': '5.6.1', 'GeographyId': '1', 'GeographyTypeId': '1', 'exportType': 'csv'})
response.raise_for_status()
raw_path.write_bytes(response.content)
lines = raw_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()[2:]
data = pl.read_csv(io.StringIO("\n".join(lines)), separator=',', infer_schema=False)
nested = [name for name, dtype in data.schema.items() if dtype.is_nested()]
data = data.with_columns(pl.col(name).map_elements(lambda value: json.dumps(value.to_list() if isinstance(value, pl.Series) else value, default=str), return_dtype=pl.Utf8) for name in nested)
data.write_csv(RAW_DIR / "ExportTable_prepared.csv")
end

import delimited "data/raw/ExportTable_prepared.csv", clear varnames(1) encoding("utf-8") stringcols(_all) bindquote(strict) maxquotedrows(unlimited)

* 2. Check inputs

assert _N > 0

* 3. Prepare data

* Standard cleaning: lower-case names, trimmed text, and numbers stored as
* text converted (destring leaves genuinely non-numeric text alone). Codes
* stay text as the source wrote them: variables named like one (coordinate,
* vectorid, dguid, NAICS, postal code) and ones with a leading zero (01).
* rename *, lower stops at a clash (Indicator next to indicator), so names
* that lower-case alike are numbered as janitor numbers them (indicator,
* indicator_2), then renamed in one group rename, which allows swaps.

local names
foreach var of varlist _all {
    local names `names' `=strlower("`var'")'
}
local dups : list dups names
while "`dups'" != "" {
    local numbered
    local before
    foreach name of local names {
        local count 1
        foreach earlier of local before {
            if "`earlier'" == "`name'" local ++count
        }
        local before `before' `name'
        if `count' > 1 {
            local name = substr("`name'", 1, 32 - strlen("_`count'")) + "_`count'"
        }
        local numbered `numbered' `name'
    }
    local names `numbered'
    local dups : list dups names
}
local old_names
local new_names
local i 0
foreach var of varlist _all {
    local ++i
    local name : word `i' of `names'
    if "`name'" != "`var'" {
        local old_names `old_names' `var'
        local new_names `new_names' `name'
    }
}
if "`old_names'" != "" {
    rename (`old_names') (`new_names')
}
quietly ds, has(type string)
local text_vars `r(varlist)'
foreach var of local text_vars {
    replace `var' = strtrim(`var')
    if regexm("`var'|", "^(coordinate|vector|vector_?id|product_?id|pid|dguid|[a-z0-9_]*_dguid|postal_?code|[a-z0-9_]*_postal_code|fsa|[a-z0-9_]*naics[a-z0-9_]*|noc|noc_[a-z0-9_]*|[a-z0-9_]*_noc|sgc|sgc_[a-z0-9_]*|[a-z0-9_]*_sgc)[|]") continue
    quietly count if regexm(`var', "^-?0[0-9]")
    if r(N) > 0 continue
    destring `var', replace
}

log close
scripts.julia:
# ============================================================
# Reproduce cmhc_get_table_data
# Purpose: Fetch the data behind MapleStats MCP's cmhc_get_table_data
#          (exact: the request the tool made, recorded while it ran)
# Inputs:  https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable
# Outputs: data/raw/ExportTable.csv; the prepared table as `data`
# ============================================================

# 0. Setup

using CSV
using DataFrames
using Downloads
using TidierData

mkpath("data/raw")

# 1. Read inputs

Downloads.request(
    "https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable";
    headers = ["Content-Type" => "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"], method = "POST", input = IOBuffer("TableId=5.6.1&GeographyId=1&GeographyTypeId=1&exportType=csv"),
    output = "data/raw/ExportTable.csv",
)

# The file opens with 2 title line(s) above its header; read the table between.

lines = readlines("data/raw/ExportTable.csv")[(2 + 1):end]
data = CSV.read(IOBuffer(join(lines, "\n")), DataFrame, types = String)

# 2. Check inputs

@assert nrow(data) > 0 "https://www03.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/hmip-pimh/en/TableMapChart/ExportTable returned no rows"

# 3. Prepare data

# Standard cleaning: snake_case names, trimmed text, empty strings as missing.

data = @chain data begin
    @clean_names
end
data = mapcols(
    col -> eltype(col) <: Union{Missing, AbstractString} ?
        [ismissing(x) || isempty(strip(x)) ? missing : strip(x) for x in col] : col,
    data,
)

# Numbers stored as text become numbers. Codes stay text as the source
# wrote them: columns named like one (coordinate, vector_id, dguid, NAICS,
# postal code) and columns with a leading zero (01, 000000001).

code_columns = r"^(coordinate|vector|vector_?id|product_?id|pid|dguid|[a-z0-9_]*_dguid|postal_?code|[a-z0-9_]*_postal_code|fsa|[a-z0-9_]*naics[a-z0-9_]*|noc|noc_[a-z0-9_]*|[a-z0-9_]*_noc|sgc|sgc_[a-z0-9_]*|[a-z0-9_]*_sgc)$"
for name in names(data)
    column = data[!, name]
    if occursin(code_columns, name)
        data[!, name] = [ismissing(x) ? missing : string(x) for x in column]
        continue
    end
    eltype(column) <: Union{Missing, AbstractString} || continue
    values = collect(skipmissing(column))
    (isempty(values) || any(v -> occursin(r"^-?0[0-9]", v), values)) && continue
    any(v -> isnothing(tryparse(Float64, v)), values) && continue
    whole = all(v -> !isnothing(tryparse(Int, v)), values)
    data[!, name] = [
        ismissing(x) ? missing : parse(whole ? Int : Float64, x) for x in column
    ]
end
